seasons.label: Studying or just starting out
seasons.hint: For this season the useful response is about direction rather than defence. Nothing here is urgent.

seasons.label: Working, at any stage
seasons.hint: Your exposure runs through an employer and a sector. These are the questions worth asking early rather than late.

seasons.label: A few years from retiring
seasons.hint: This season is deliberately thin. Most of what matters here is a question for a licensed advisor rather than something a public page should answer, and saying so is more useful than padding the list.

seasons.label: Retired
seasons.hint: On a fixed income the exposure is prices rather than employment, which inverts which of the two lists matters to you.
